variants.title: Virtual air table: elastic collision of two pucks
variants.sample: Pucks of 200 g and 300 g with springy magnet rings (e = 1)
variants.method: Elastic: strobe tracks at several sideways offsets
variants.unknown: whether momentum and kinetic energy are conserved
variants.note: SIMULATED DATA. With springy rings the kinetic energy is kept as well as the momentum.

source.title: Generic apparatus
source.note: virtual bench: masses and restitution are settings, not measured values

variants.title: Virtual air table: inelastic collision of two pucks
variants.sample: Pucks of 200 g and 300 g with soft felt rings (e = 0.4)
variants.method: Inelastic: strobe tracks at several sideways offsets
variants.unknown: whether momentum and kinetic energy are conserved
variants.note: SIMULATED DATA. Soft rings keep the momentum but lose part of the kinetic energy, most of it in a head-on hit.
